name: The weight of her memory
source:
After a couple of weeks, he lost his mother in a tragic house fire. Miles Reed, a 23-year-old university student studying medicine, has to navigate the process of grief, ptsd and loss. believing what happened was his fault, he becomes a a hollow shell of who he was. until one rainy day a kind stag shows him a path to begin healing, physically and mentally. they learn from each other from their losses, they experience each others comfort and an unbreakable bond forms between them. One that blossoms into romance and love. 

[From [url=https://kami-workshop.itch.io/the-weight-of-her-memory]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
几周后，他在一场悲惨的房屋火灾中失去了母亲。迈尔斯·里德 (Miles Reed) 是一名23岁的医学专业大学生，他必须应对悲伤、创伤后应激障碍和失落的过程。相信所发生的事情都是他的错，他就变成了一个空壳。直到一个下雨天，一只善良的雄鹿向他展示了一条开始治愈身体和精神的道路。他们从彼此的损失中互相学习，体验到彼此的安慰，并在他们之间形成了牢不可破的纽带。一种绽放浪漫和爱情的花朵。

[来自[url=https://kami-workshop.itch.io/the-weight-of-her-memory]Itch.io[/url]]
